status: REFERENCE VALUES, NOT QUOTES. Lenders are fictional. Loan rates are anchored to the CMF interest-rate certificate 09/2026 (bank averages for August 2026) and set below the market average on purpose, so the savings we report against the bank loan are conservative. Factoring rates come from public Chilean rate ranges. See docs/financial-catalog.md for every source.

market.clp_rate_reference: BCCh monetary policy rate (TPM) 4.50%, held unanimously at the 2026-09-08 meeting
market.cny_rate_reference: Assumption: 1-year CNY loan prime rate area minus a margin; only used for the forward's interest parity
market.stamp_tax_reference: DL 3.475 art. 1 no. 3: 0.066% per month or fraction, capped at 0.8%; 0.332% for sight credits
market.cmf_certificate: CMF Certificado 09/2026 (Diario Oficial 2026-09-15): interés corriente, non-adjustable CLP, 90 days or more, 200-5,000 UF = 20.06%/yr; less than 90 days, up to 5,000 UF = 33.34%/yr; foreign currency up to 2,000 UF = 10.26%/yr, above = 5.78%/yr
market.tmc_certificate: CMF Certificado 09/2026 (Diario Oficial 2026-09-15). Tasa máxima convencional (TMC, legal maximum = 1.5 x the average): non-adjustable CLP under 90 days, up to 5,000 UF 50.01%/yr, above 5,000 UF 8.40%; 90 days or more, 200-5,000 UF 30.09%, above 5,000 UF 9.96%; foreign currency up to 2,000 UF 15.39%, above 2,000 UF 8.67%. Factoring (assignment of invoices, Ley 19.983) is a sale of credits, not a credit operation, so no TMC applies.

products.name: Export factoring, non-recourse (bank)
products.stamp_tax_note: Assignment of invoices (Ley 19.983) is a sale of credits, not a credit operation: no stamp tax
products.requirements: Invoice to an insured or creditworthy foreign buyer; assignment notified to the debtor. A non-recourse factor does not buy an invoice whose debtor has already announced a delay.
products.rate_reference: Public Chilean ranges 2026: non-recourse 1.5%-2.2%/month, with recourse 1.2%-1.8%/month (portalinnova.cl, 2026-05-25); 0.89%-2.5%/month by payer risk (chita.cl, 2026-03-09). Low end because the buyer is insured

products.name: Fintech factoring, with recourse (fast onboarding)
products.requirements: Online onboarding; funds in 24 h. With recourse: if the buyer has not paid 30 days after the expected date, the exporter repays the advance.
products.rate_reference: With-recourse factoring 1.2%-1.8%/month (portalinnova.cl, 2026-05-25); 0.89%-2.5%/month by payer risk (chita.cl, 2026-03-09). Upper end because a fintech charges for speed and buys delayed invoices

products.name: Letter of credit discounting
products.requirements: Only receivables backed by a confirmed documentary letter of credit.
products.rate_reference: 3-month CME Term SOFR 4.04% (2026-10-09) + 6.2% spread = 10.2%/yr. LC discounting usually costs SOFR + 1.5%-3%, so this is high on purpose: it can only make a plan that uses it look worse
products.legal_max_note: USD discount, tickets up to 2,000 UF (CLP 82M): TMC 15.39%/yr. Above 2,000 UF the TMC is 8.67%, under our 10.2%

products.name: Confirming (supplier payment extension)
products.requirements: Supplier enrolled in the bank's confirming program.
products.rate_reference: Bank confirming programs; below the CMF short-term average because the risk is the buyer's (our SME)
products.legal_max_note: CLP, 60 days, up to 5,000 UF (CLP 205M): TMC 50.01%/yr. Above 5,000 UF the TMC is 8.40%, under our 13.2%

products.name: Working capital loan (default bank credit)
products.requirements: Two years of financial statements; collateral or personal guarantee.
products.rate_reference: CMF certificate 09/2026: bank average 20.06%/yr (90 days or more, 200-5,000 UF) and 33.34%/yr (under 90 days, up to 5,000 UF). We use 14% (a collateralized exporter with a good record), which makes the default loan cheaper and our savings conservative
products.legal_max_note: CLP up to 5,000 UF (CLP 205M): TMC 50.01%/yr under 90 days, 30.09% for 90 days or more. Above 5,000 UF the TMC is 8.40% / 9.96%, under our 14%

products.name: FOGAPE-guaranteed working capital loan
products.requirements: Net annual sales up to 100,000 UF (medium firms 25,001-100,000 UF get 50% guarantee coverage); financing up to 15,000 UF; no protests or overdue debts.
products.rate_reference: FOGAPE rules (CORFO / BancoEstado administrator); rate below the unguaranteed loan because half the risk is state-guaranteed
products.legal_max_note: CLP, 365 days, up to 5,000 UF (CLP 205M): TMC 30.09%/yr. Above 5,000 UF the TMC is 9.96%, under our 10.2% + 1.3% guarantee fee

products.name: Pre-export loan in USD (PAE)
products.stamp_tax_note: Exempt: DL 3.475 art. 24 no. 11 (credits that finance exports), provided the export is made for at least the loan amount before it matures (SII Ord. 2402/2016)
products.requirements: Export contract or shipping documents; repaid in USD with the export proceeds.
products.rate_reference: CMF certificate 09/2026: foreign-currency bank average 10.26%/yr (up to 2,000 UF) and 5.78%/yr (above); Term SOFR + exporter spread
products.legal_max_note: USD, every allowed ticket (729-7,291 UF): TMC 15.39%/yr up to 2,000 UF and 8.67% above; our 6.8% is under both

products.name: Credit line / overdraft
products.stamp_tax_note: Credits on sight / without maturity pay a flat 0.332% (DL 3.475 art. 1 no. 3)
products.requirements: Pre-approved line on the current account.
products.rate_reference: 2.1%/month = 25.2%/yr, under the CMF short-term average of 33.34%/yr (certificate 09/2026)
products.legal_max_note: CLP, 30 days, at most 1,458 UF: TMC 50.01%/yr

products.name: CNY forward (sell CNY, cash-settled)
products.requirements: FX framework agreement (contrato marco) with the bank; notional up to the hedged receivable.
products.rate_reference: Covered interest parity CLP vs CNY + bank spread
